content.short: Tipsy Turtles is an interactive Cardano NFT and animation project featuring characters Ted and Tony.
content.description: Tipsy Turtles is a unique intellectual property (IP) project on the Cardano blockchain, centered around an animated series featuring the characters Ted and Tony. The project provides holders with exclusive 'TripHut' access, offering travel-related perks and community benefits. A standout feature of the ecosystem is IP participation, where NFT holders can actively contribute to co-writing future seasons of the show. By blending digital collectibles with professional animation and community-led storytelling, Tipsy Turtles offers a dynamic experience that bridges the gap between Web3 and media.
content.meta: Tipsy Turtles is a Cardano NFT project featuring animated storytelling and exclusive travel perks. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
